entries.name: The Witch
entries.content: the Witch is an unknown entity that travels the world. Not much is known about her because she can take whatever form she pleases. As a result, she is very much unknown to the General public and the only people who know of her are the Lamias and the only thing that they know of her is that she is their creator. The witch is usually responsible for the creation of the Lamias’ eggs that she gives to unsuspecting people as a thank-you gift. From there the Lamias will serve their new master with great love and attention.

entries.name: Lamia
entries.content:
Information: Lamias is a serpent race that originated from the witch. They do not know their origins per se other than that they hatch from an egg and the one who made the egg was the witch. Lamias do not have too many directives in their lives with the exception of serving their new master that they take very seriously. So seriously in fact that it is very common for a Lamia to become a yandere because that is the only thing that they know which is serving their master.

As well Lamias are naturally cold-blooded and so are unable to maintain their body heat and as a result do need to cuddle their Master to receive warmth.

entries.name: psychotic breaks
entries.content: Lamias do have a tendency to experience psychotic breaks due to their yandere personality. If their master were to talk to another individual at least in a romantic sense, the Lamia will get jealous and angry. The lamia will try to get their Master to leave the area due to sheer possession. If the Lamia is pushed too far they will snap and kill the individual who is flirting with their master.

entries.name: venom glands
entries.content: all Lamias do have a venom gland, meaning that they are perfectly able to inject venom into their enemies. When a Lamia bites down on their enemy they will inject a venom into their bloodstream which will begin to kill their enemy. Lamias will begin to show their teeth when they are extremely angry. They may even start to leak the venom glands during times of high stress.
